items.name: ORL Labs LLC
items.facts: Class II recall by ORL Labs LLC. Product: ORL Organic Oral Care Cinnamint toothpaste, 4 oz., ORL, ORL Labs, LLC, Scottsdale, Arizona, USA UPC# 850006245512. Reason: Cross-contamination: The firm was notified by the FDA of sampling results which found the presence of progesterone, estradiol, or dehydroepiandrosterone (DHEA). Status: Ongoing.
items.summary: ORL Labs LLC is conducting a Class II recall of ORL Organic Oral Care Cinnamint toothpaste due to hormone cross-contamination.

items.name: IBeautiStore.com
items.facts: Class I recall by IBeautiStore.com. Product: UMARY Acido Hialuronico, also known as: "New Hyaluronic Acid 850mg Sealed 30 Caps", Suplemento Alimenticio, Contenido Neto: 30 capletas de 850 mg.. items.kind: Label update (label has a boxed warning)
items.name: NORETHINDRONE
items.facts: Updated label for NORETHINDRONE (Lupin Pharmaceuticals, Inc.). Boxed warning: Cigarette smoking greatly increases the possibility of suffering heart attacks and strokes. Women who use oral contraceptives are strongly advised not to smoke.

why_it_matters.text: Particulate matter contamination in injectable drugs presents direct quality and patient safety risks that demand close manufacturing oversight [D-0185-2027].
